entities.summary: Alphonse Boudard was a French novelist and playwright. He won the 1977 Prix Renaudot for Les Combattants du petit bonheur. Boudard's 1995 novel Dying childhood  was awarded and recognised by the French Academy with a Grand Prix du roman de l'Académie française.
